answer: Every agent locks a 40-unit bond in a public vault before earning: the vault publishes a referral graph, so a star of 100 fakes pointing at one sponsor shows at a glance. Any peer can whisper a dispute, and a falcon-fast audit checks it within one epoch. If they share one sponsor and payout address, all 100 bonds are slashed: 100 x 40 = 4,000 units lost against a 30-unit reward. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted.
